infobox.usage: Unlocks the trunk of the blue car at the unlocked villa on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: SMW car key (SMW) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: An SMW folding car key with locking buttons.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - On a box at the construction site near the locked villa

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Trunk of the blue car at the unlocked villa on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Yellow keycard spawn location
- Weapon spawn
- Loose loot (Roubles, Provisions)
